subject: implementer
reason: Single Blazor page in WebApp (one file, ~15 lines) needs the requested page clamped to the last page.
mode_reason: Single Blazor page in WebApp (one file, ~15 lines) needs the requested page clamped to the last page.

items.goal: Opening the catalog with a page number past the last page (e.g. /?page=50 with 101 products, 9 per page) shows the last page's products and a pager reading '12 / 12', with or without brand/type filters; valid pages and filters behave as today.
items.verifyReason: Visible pager and product grid behaviour on the catalog page.

alternatives.reason: Extra round trip and redirect handling on static SSR with streaming rendering; the story only requires showing the last page.
API returning a different page than requested changes its contract; the bug is in the WebApp.

items.reason: A valid positive page number past the last page can throw instead of showing the last page, violating the goal with and without filters.

follow_ups.title: Catalog page numbers below 1 (?page=0 or negative) are not checked
follow_ups.reason: They are passed to the catalog API as a negative page index; the story covers only pages past the last one.

items.reason: A valid positive page number past the last page can throw instead of showing the last page, violating the goal with and without filters.
items.fix: Obtain the count through a safe initial request when the requested offset would overflow, then fetch the clamped last page. Keep the correction within Catalog.razor.
